main.description: Bring a document back from the bin with everything that went there with it, and nothing that was deleted from inside it earlier. Its creator or an owner of its context may; to anyone else it is not there.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: Nothing in the bin by that id that the caller may restore.

errors.name: PathTaken
errors.description: A live node now has its path. Rename or move that one first.

errors.name: ParentInBin
errors.description: What it was in is itself in the bin. Restore that first.
